battle.name: 烏邁耶入侵高盧
battle.brief: 公元719年，烏邁耶王朝自安達盧斯舉大軍越過庇里牛斯山，進攻阿基坦與法蘭克邊境；土魯斯公爵厄德於貝爾河擊潰入侵軍，斬其統帥阿卜杜·拉赫曼·加菲基。卡面羅馬標槍並未出現於此役，但它以擲槍壓制盾牆的任務，正由法蘭克與阿基坦步兵的擲矛與飛斧、安達盧斯輕騎的標槍完成。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 這場戰爭發生於公元719年，戰場在今法國西南部奧克西塔尼亞大區上加龍省一帶，即貝爾河（Berre）與加龍河匯合處附近，距土魯斯東南約十五至二十公里。交戰一方是烏邁耶哈里發國的安達盧斯軍隊：作戰序列上隸屬大馬士革的哈里發，最前線的指揮權握在安達盧斯總督（wali）手中，719年出戰者是烏邁耶宗室阿卜杜·拉赫曼·加菲基，兵員為安達盧斯本地步兵，加上自馬格里布與撒哈拉地帶北來的柏柏爾及阿拉伯騎兵，並以納博訥（Narbonne）與塞普提曼尼亞為前進基地與補給樞紐。另一方是法蘭克—阿基坦聯軍：法蘭克方面由宮相查理·馬泰（Charles Martel）主持軍政，實際的戰場指揮則落在阿基坦公爵兼土魯斯伯爵厄德（Eudes，又作 Odo）手上，兵力以阿基坦公國與加龍河下游的軍隊為主，另有法蘭克騎兵，以及結盟的加斯孔人與塞普提曼尼亞的西哥特系部眾參與。第三方則是仍握塞普提曼尼亞的烏邁耶前哨，以及名存實亡的墨洛溫王權：克洛維斯三世在719年去世，其後是提烏德里克四世與提烏德里克三世，這條王朝更替線正橫在戰場北面的王都一帶。還要說明的是，戰爭列表所記的「烏邁耶入侵高盧」（Islamic invasion of Gaul）以719年第一次越過庇里牛斯山、深入高盧的遠征為起點，同一系列的北伐最終在732年的普瓦捷決戰收場，本役正是那個系列的第一戰。必須指出，這是加洛林家族奠基者查理·馬泰治下，法蘭克與阿基坦第一次在同一戰場上合力對抗安達盧斯軍隊，也是十三年後普瓦捷決戰的直接前奏。
countriesEn: This war took place in AD 719 in what is now the Haute-Garonne department of the Occitanie region in south-western France, that is, near the confluence of the Berre and the Garonne, some fifteen to twenty kilometres south-east of Toulouse. One side was the Andalusi army of the Umayyad Caliphate: in the chain of command it answered to the caliph in Damascus, while operational control lay with the wali, the governor of al-Andalus, the commander in the field in 719 being the Umayyad kinsman Abd al-Rahman al-Ghafiqi. His troops were Andalusi infantry proper, reinforced by Berber and Arab cavalry sent north from the Maghrib and the Sahara, and they used Narbonne and Septimania as their forward base and supply hub. The other side was the Frankish-Aquitanian coalition: on the Frankish side military affairs were directed by the mayor of the palace Charles Martel, while actual battlefield command belonged to Eudes, duke of Aquitaine and count of Toulouse, whose forces were those of the Duchy of Aquitaine and of the lower Garonne, supplemented by Frankish cavalry and by allied Gascon and Visigothic elements from Septimania. Third parties were the Umayyad outposts that still held Septimania, and a Merovingian kingship existing in name only: Clovis III died in 719 and was followed by Theuderic IV and then Theuderic III, and that line of dynastic succession ran along the royal centres just north of the battlefield. It should also be said that the war lists set down under the name Islamic invasion of Gaul take their starting point in the first crossing of the Pyrenees and the deep push into Gaul of AD 719, while the same series of northern raids came to its end at the decisive battle of Poitiers in 732; the present campaign is the first battle of that series. It should be noted that this was the first occasion on which the Franks, under Charles Martel, founder of the Carolingian house, fought an Andalusi army shoulder to shoulder with the Aquitanians, and it is the direct prelude to the decisive battle of Poitiers thirteen years later.
people: 阿基坦方面的核心人物是厄德（Eudes，又作 Odo、Oddo），七世紀末至八世紀初阿基坦與土魯斯最具實力的君主。717年安達盧斯軍隊越過庇里牛斯山時，他以公國軍隊擋住通往波爾多的進軍，其子桑希爾德（Sanhild）於718年的敗仗中陣亡；719年重整旗鼓之後，他在貝爾河擊潰加菲基的遠征軍，把安達盧斯的勢力重新逐出加龍河下游；其子埃梅里克（Émeric）在720年第二次貝爾河之戰中與父並肩作戰，父子聯手把入侵者一路追到庇里牛斯山北麓。烏邁耶方面，阿卜杜·拉赫曼·加菲基是哈里發希沙姆的釋僕與親族，一般認為與後來開創科爾多瓦埃米國的 Abd al-Rahman 一系血緣相近；719年他率安達盧斯與柏柏爾混編的軍隊北進，敗於貝爾河並且陣亡，是本役最關鍵的人事轉折。同期安達盧斯總督尤素福·伊本·阿卜杜·拉赫曼·菲赫里（Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri）在717至718年執政，敗績之後一度下台，720年復任，並代表哈里發國與查理·馬泰議和。編年史方面，弗雷德加爾（Fredegar）編年史的續篇記錄了719年的貝爾河之戰，匿名的《法蘭克史》（Historia Francorum）與《法蘭克王國編年史》（Annales regni Francorum）則保存了720年戰役與議和的經過；後者732年條記下柏柏爾將領巴拉克（Bala，條文中作 Balac）陣亡，可見這批安達盧斯軍隊裏柏柏爾指揮官的份量在十餘年間不斷上升。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Aquitanian side was Eudes (also written Odo or Oddo), the most powerful ruler of Aquitaine and Toulouse at the end of the seventh and the beginning of the eighth century. When the Andalusi army crossed the Pyrenees in 717 he met it with the forces of his duchy on the road to Bordeaux, and his son Sanhild was killed in the defeat of 718; after pulling his army together again, he beat al-Ghafiqi's expedition at the Berre in 719 and drove Andalusi power back out of the lower Garonne. His son Emeric fought alongside him in the second battle of the Berre in 720, and together father and son pursued the invaders to the northern foot of the Pyrenees. On the Umayyad side, Abd al-Rahman al-Ghafiqi was a mawla and kinsman of the caliph Hisham, and is generally held to have been close in blood to the Abd al-Rahman line that would later found the emirate of Córdoba; in 719 he led north a mixed Andalusi and Berber army, was defeated at the Berre and was killed there, which is the single most consequential personal turn of the campaign. At the same time Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri, governor of al-Andalus, held office from 717 to 718, was put aside after the defeat, was restored in 720, and negotiated the settlement with Charles Martel on behalf of the caliphate. As for the chroniclers, the continuation of Fredegar's chronicle records the battle of the Berre in 719, while the anonymous Historia Francorum and the Annales regni Francorum preserve the story of the campaign of 720 and of the peace that followed; the latter, in its entry for 732, records the death of the Berber commander Bala (Balac in the text), which shows how steadily the weight of Berber commanders grew in these Andalusi armies over the following dozen years.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬標槍（Pilum）是羅馬共和國至帝國早期標準的擲槍：槍身由中空的松木槍管接上約半公尺的鐵矛幹組成，卡面所寫的「半米長、槍幹中空」指的正是這截鐵矛幹與中空管身，尾端另裝鉛或鐵的配重，使它像飛鏢一樣飛行、命中後急墜；投擲約三十至三十五公尺後便失去力道；一旦捅穿盾牌，中空的木管會當場折斷，只留一截彎曲的殘枝卡在盾上，射手的手臂受傷、盾牌難以再用，敵兵只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。必須說明的是：本役的戰場上並沒有羅馬軍團。719年的高盧西部，羅馬的正統軍隊早已西撤四百餘年，羅馬的繼承者是東方的拜占庭帝國；而恰恰在717至718年，同一個哈里發的軍隊剛剛在君士坦丁堡城下與這支最後的羅馬軍隊對峙。所以標槍並不是貝爾河戰場上實際出現的兵器，關於本役的裝備，只能就其戰術功能作比較。真正填補這個位置的是三種東西：法蘭克與阿基坦步兵的短柄擲矛與沉重的有鬚戰斧（可以擲出，也可以砍劈）；安達盧斯與馬格里布輕騎所用的標槍與短弓；以及雙方步卒用來遮蔽身體的圓盾與並排構成的盾牆。擲槍的戰術任務——在接戰之前先用投射武器把敵方盾牆打成廢物，使對手無法舉盾衝鋒——正是這場戰役的關鍵所在：安達盧斯騎兵需要靠速度繞擊，而步兵能否在盾牆受損的情況下頂住衝鋒，決定了戰局的走向。此外，本役屬野外交鋒，沒有攻城器可用；後勤以騎兵馬匹、騡子、柏柏爾人慣用的駱駝，以及從地中海港口納博訥經陸路與加龍河河運運來的糧秣、箭桿與備用馬匹為主。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on the card is the standard throwing javelin of the Roman Republic and early Empire: a hollow pine shaft joined to an iron shank of roughly half a metre, which is what the card's own description of a half-metre throwing spear with a hollow shaft refers to, and a lead or iron butt-cap that made it fly like a dart and drop sharply on impact. Beyond some thirty to thirty-five metres it lost its force, and once it had pierced a shield the hollow shaft would snap off on the spot, leaving a bent stub jammed in the shield, the thrower's arm lamed and the shield hard to use again, so that the enemy could only fall back behind cover with half a javelin still in the wood. It must be said that no Roman legion stood on this battlefield. In the western Gaul of AD 719 the regular Roman army had withdrawn more than four centuries earlier, and the heir of Rome lay in the East, in the Byzantine Empire; and it was precisely in 717 and 718 that the army of the same caliph had confronted that last Roman army before the walls of Constantinople. The pilum therefore was not a weapon present on the field of the Berre, and the equipment of this campaign can only be discussed by comparison of tactical function. Three things filled the place it occupied: the short throwing spears and the heavy bearded axes of Frankish and Aquitanian infantry, which could be thrown as well as swung; the javelins and short bows of the Andalusi and Maghribi light horse; and the round shields and the shield walls that the infantry of both sides used to cover their bodies. The tactical task of the pilum — softening the enemy shield wall with missiles before contact so that the enemy could not charge behind it — is exactly the crux of this battle: the Andalusi horse needed room to run round the flank, and whether the infantry could hold the charge with a battered shield wall decided the issue. In addition, this was a field engagement and no siege engines were available; the logistics rested on cavalry horses, mules, the camels habitually used by the Berbers, and on grain, arrow shafts and remounts brought up from the Mediterranean port of Narbonne by road and by river traffic on the Garonne.
tactics: 本役沒有留下任何一份戰術條令，作戰方式只能由編年史的零星記載與當時的兵制推想而得。烏邁耶一方採用的是安達盧斯—馬格里布式的混合兵種打法：以柏柏爾與阿拉伯輕騎為骨幹的騎兵團在兩翼與側後反覆掠奪，迫使法蘭克—阿基坦聯軍的縱隊不停收縮；步兵線在中央展開，弓箭手與投槍手輪流射擊，消耗敵方銳氣；騎兵則利用加龍河下游開闊的平原與夏季乾燥堅硬的地面，尋找正面突破的時機。史料沒有明說加菲基本人的部署細節，但編年史提到安達盧斯營地在行軍途中屢遭夜襲與側擊，說明其縱隊警戒與宿營佈署並不周全，縱隊一旦拉長便容易受制於分散打擊。法蘭克—阿基坦聯軍的應對則更貼合地形：厄德選擇貝爾河與加龍河匯合處作戰，利用河曲、沼澤與岸邊樹林限制騎兵展開，把戰鬥壓成步兵與盾牆之間的角力；法蘭克騎兵不投入正面的糾纏，而是待機打擊脫離陣線的敵騎。奪取主動權之後，聯軍沒有停在河邊，而是連續追擊，把殘兵一路趕到庇里牛斯山北麓的關口，然後在未經大規模決戰的情況下接受停戰，劃出新的實際界線。整體而言，決定勝負的不是任何一件單兵武器，而是投射火力與盾牆之間的交換比——這正是卡面標槍所代表的戰術問題。
tacticsEn: This campaign left behind no manual of tactics at all, so the way it was fought can only be reconstructed from scattered notices in the chronicles and from the military systems of the day. The Umayyad side fought the mixed style usual to al-Andalus and the Maghrib: light horse drawn from Berber and Arab tribes harried the two flanks and the rear, forcing the Frankish-Aquitanian column to contract again and again; the infantry line deployed in the centre, archers and javelin-throwers shooting in turn to wear down the enemy's edge; and the horse, taking advantage of the open plain of the lower Garonne and the hard dry ground of summer, waited for a chance to break through in front. The sources give no detail of al-Ghafiqi's own deployment, but the chronicles record that the Andalusi camp was repeatedly attacked by night and from the flank during its marches, which shows that its column escort and its camp arrangements were not tight, and that a column once stretched out was exposed to piecemeal attack. The Frankish-Aquitanian answer fitted the ground better: Eudes chose to fight where the Berre runs into the Garonne, using the bend of the river, the marshes and the trees along the banks to deny the horse room to deploy, compressing the business into a struggle between infantry and shield wall; the Frankish horse did not join the mêlée in front but waited its chance to strike at enemy riders who had broken out of line. Having won the initiative, the coalition did not halt on the river bank: it pursued the broken men all the way to the passes of the northern Pyrenees, and then, without a second pitched battle, accepted a truce and drew a new effective frontier. On the whole, what decided the issue was no individual weapon but the exchange ratio between missile fire and shield wall, which is precisely the tactical problem the pilum on the card stands for.
data: 本役的數字極為稀少，而且多屬可以核對的地理與年代量度。編年史只給出年份，沒有留下兵力與傷亡的具體數目；關於戰役規模只有「大軍」「眾多」一類的形容，關於勝負則只記下加菲基陣亡以及追擊至山口。時間上，本役繫於公元719年，月份不見於史料；按高盧的徵兵與收穫季節，以及編年史把720年戰役緊接着記載的做法，合理的推斷是夏末初秋之交，戰役的月份欄位即依此填列。距離方面：納博訥（古塞普提曼尼亞首府）至土魯斯約二百八十公里；土魯斯至庇里牛斯山主山口（松波特一線）約二百五十公里；貝爾河匯入加龍河之處在土魯斯東南約十五至二十公里；貝爾河戰場至波爾多約二百四十公里，而遠征軍自越過山口到占據波爾多要用上一年，可見這條往返糧秣線的長度。武器尺度可參考卡面標槍的形制：羅馬制式標槍的槍管遠長於鐵矛幹，連槍管計約二公尺（卡面所寫的半米，指的正是鐵矛幹本身），槍管約一米半上下，較輕的一型約一公斤上下，重的一型可達兩公斤有餘，標準射程約三十至三十五公尺——這套數字說明羅馬式的投射武器必須在前線數十步內才能發揮效果，也說明為何它必須由整排同步擲出而非零散投擲。法蘭克王國此時的版圖包括奧斯特拉西亞、紐斯特里亞、勃艮第與塞文山以北的普羅旺斯部分，全境靠查理·馬泰以宮相的權力統合，而墨洛溫王權在719年克洛維斯三世去世後一度再無實權。
dataEn: The numbers for this campaign are extremely scarce, and what survives is mostly geographical and chronological measurement that can be checked. The chronicles give only the year; no figure for the size of the armies or for casualties survives, only adjectives such as great and numerous, while of the outcome they record the death of al-Ghafiqi and the pursuit to the mountain passes. As to time, the campaign is fixed to AD 719 and the month does not appear in the sources; from the recruiting and harvest season in Gaul, and from the practice of the chronicles in recording the campaign of 720 immediately afterwards, a reasonable inference puts the fighting in the turn of summer into early autumn, and the month field of the card is filled in on that basis. As to distance: Narbonne, the ancient capital of Septimania, lies about two hundred and eighty kilometres from Toulouse; Toulouse is about two hundred and fifty kilometres from the main Pyrenean passes on the Somport line; the point where the Berre runs into the Garonne is some fifteen to twenty kilometres south-east of Toulouse; and the battlefield of the Berre is about two hundred and forty kilometres from Bordeaux, while the expedition took a full year to travel from the passes to the occupation of Bordeaux, which gives the length of the supply line that had to be walked both ways. For weapon dimensions one can use the form of the pilum on the card: the shaft of the Roman throwing javelin was far longer than its iron shank, some two metres in all (the half metre of the card is the iron shank itself), the wooden shaft some one and a half metres, the lighter type weighed about a kilogram and the heavier rather more than two, and the effective range was roughly thirty to thirty-five metres. Those figures show that a Roman-style missile had to be loosed within a few dozen paces of the enemy line, and they also show why it had to be thrown by a rank in unison rather than scattered singly. The Frankish realm at this time comprised Austrasia, Neustria, Burgundy and that part of Provence north of the Cévennes, all of it held together by the authority Charles Martel exercised as mayor of the palace, while after the death of Clovis III in 719 the Merovingian kingship possessed no real power at all.
cause: 起釀既有遠因，也有近因。遠因是七世紀初安達盧斯征服伊比利亞之後，烏邁耶在西方的前沿從科爾多瓦、托雷多一帶向庇里牛斯山推移：711年瓜達萊特之役摧毀西哥特王國最後的野戰軍，此後數十年間安達盧斯完成對伊比利亞的整合，把山口以北的塞普提曼尼亞變成前線堡壘；到717至718年，安達盧斯總督菲赫里已率軍奪取塞普提曼尼亞並攻入波爾多，烏邁耶朝南歐推進的勢頭因此成形。近因則是阿基坦的抵抗與法蘭克的介入：厄德在718年損折（其子桑希爾德陣亡）之後重整軍力，並得到法蘭克方面的支持；而法蘭克宮相查理·馬泰自718年掌權之後，亟需把墨洛溫王權空出的實際軍事權抓在自己手上，於是把萊茵河下游與塞納河流域的資源投向西南。於是719年兩股力量在同一條戰線上相遇：加菲基率軍越過庇里牛斯山，目標是控制加龍河渡口與波爾多，把安達盧斯的邊界推到羅亞爾河；而厄德與法蘭克聯軍的目標是切斷這條推進線，保住阿基坦公國以及通往圖爾與奧爾良的道路。同時，717至718年君士坦丁堡之圍已使哈里發國元氣大損，新兵與戰馬的補充落後，安達盧斯方面在遠征時其實已經在人力物力上吃緊。
causeEn: The outbreak had both remote and immediate causes. The remote cause is the movement of the Umayyad frontier in the west from the neighbourhood of Córdoba and Toledo towards the Pyrenees after the conquest of Hispania at the beginning of the seventh century: the battle of Guadalete in 711 destroyed the last field army of the Visigothic kingdom, and in the decades that followed al-Andalus completed the consolidation of Hispania and turned Septimania north of the passes into a frontier stronghold. By 717 and 718 the governor of al-Andalus, al-Fihri, had already seized Septimania and driven into Bordeaux, and so the Umayyad thrust into south-western Europe took shape. The immediate cause is Aquitanian resistance combined with Frankish intervention: after his losses of 718, in which his son Sanhild was killed, Eudes pulled his forces together again and obtained Frankish support, while Charles Martel, mayor of the palace since 718, was in urgent need to seize the real military power left vacant by the Merovingian kingship and therefore turned the resources of the lower Rhine and the Seine basin towards the south-west. Thus in 719 the two forces met on the same line: al-Ghafiqi crossed the Pyrenees with the aim of holding the crossings of the Garonne and Bordeaux and pushing the Umayyad frontier forward to the Loire, while Eudes and the Frankish coalition aimed to cut that thrust off and preserve the Duchy of Aquitaine together with the roads to Tours and Orléans. At the same time the siege of Constantinople in 717 and 718 had exhausted the caliphate, and the flow of fresh recruits and remounts was running behind schedule, so that the Andalusi side was already short of men and horses when it marched north.
impact: 本役的影響，最要緊的一點是把「安達盧斯入侵高盧」變成了一種可以重複的軍事模式，而不是一次性的意外。719年的敗績加上720年同一條河上的第二次敗績，使烏邁耶軍隊在庇里牛斯山北麓被徹底擋住；720至721年間菲赫里代表哈里發國與查理·馬泰達成的協議，確認塞普提曼尼亞仍屬安達盧斯，而阿基坦、普瓦圖瓦與圖爾一線歸法蘭克—阿基坦聯軍，庇里牛斯山遂成為新的實際前線。對法蘭克而言，這場戰役意味著法蘭克的軍力第一次從萊茵河與塞納河被抽調到西南，並且第一次與阿基坦公國在同一面旗幟下並肩作戰；查理·馬泰由此在阿基坦建立了超越墨洛溫王名的實際權力，也為十二年後普瓦捷的決戰預先集結了一支久經戰陣、而非靠傭兵湊成的聯軍。對阿基坦而言，厄德父子守住了公國的存亡，恢復了對波爾多的控制，讓阿基坦在往後百年成為法蘭克王國西南側最重要的支柱之一。對烏邁耶哈里發國而言，敗績並不致命：安達盧斯仍在西班牙與北非握有龐大兵源與基地，損失的是一批能征善戰的柏柏爾與安達盧斯兵員，以及在西方第一次受挫的士氣；下一次大規模北伐因此要等到732年，而那一次帶來的是托爾蓋戰役的敗績與真正的退潮。
impactEn: The most important effect of this campaign was that it turned an Andalusi invasion of Gaul into a repeatable military pattern rather than a one-off accident. The defeat of 719, followed by a second defeat on the same river in 720, stopped the Umayyad armies dead at the northern foot of the Pyrenees; and the settlement concluded between al-Fihri, on behalf of the caliphate, and Charles Martel in 720 and 721 confirmed Septimania as Andalusi while Aquitaine, Poitou and the line of Tours fell to the Frankish-Aquitanian coalition, so that the Pyrenees became the new effective frontier. For the Franks the campaign meant that Frankish forces were for the first time drawn away from the Rhine and the Seine into the south-west, and that for the first time they fought side by side with the Duchy of Aquitaine under one banner; Charles Martel thereby established in Aquitaine a real power that overhung the Merovingian name, and he gathered there in advance the coalition that was to face the decision at Poitiers twelve years later — seasoned troops rather than a mercenary rabble. For Aquitaine, Eudes and his son saved the existence of the duchy, recovered control of Bordeaux, and left Aquitaine for the following century as one of the firmest pillars on the south-western side of the Frankish realm. For the Umayyad caliphate the defeat was not mortal: al-Andalus still held vast reserves of men and bases in Spain and North Africa; what it lost was a body of able Berber and Andalusi soldiers and the first check its prestige had suffered in the west. The next large northern raid therefore had to wait until 732, and it brought the defeat at Tours and the real ebb of the Umayyad tide.
result: 結果是安達盧斯遠征軍在貝爾河全軍覆沒：719年的那一戰，厄德率法蘭克—阿基坦聯軍擊潰加菲基的軍隊，統帥陣亡，殘部越過庇里牛斯山退回落腳的納博訥與塞普提曼尼亞，波爾多方向的推進被完全逆轉。720年，哈里發國再派一支規模更大的軍隊北上，試圖雪恥；厄德與其子埃梅里克在貝爾河再度擊敗來敵，聯軍追擊至山口，逼得對方求和，隨後在沒有大規模決戰的情況下立約停戰，劃定了以庇里牛斯山為界、以塞普提曼尼亞為安達盧斯屬地的分界。兩戰之後，安達盧斯的北方攻勢中止了整整十二年，直到732年才以更強的兵力重啟北伐，最終在普瓦捷與圖爾之間被查理·馬泰擊敗。就本役本身而言，可確認的結果是：加菲基陣亡、安達盧斯喪失對波爾多的軍事控制、聯軍取得庇里牛斯山以北的戰略主動權；但戰役的過程細節幾乎全部散佚，傷亡數字、雙方實際兵力與陣形都沒有留下可靠記載，只能由編年史「追至山口」一類的描述，與719年、720年兩次敗績接連出現的編年次序，拼湊出這場戰爭的樣貌。
resultEn: The outcome was the destruction of the Andalusi expeditionary army on the Berre: in the battle of 719 Eudes and the Frankish-Aquitanian coalition broke al-Ghafiqi's army, the commander was killed, the survivors went back over the Pyrenees to Narbonne and Septimania, and the advance towards Bordeaux was completely reversed. In 720 the caliphate sent a larger army north to wipe out the shame, and at the Berre once more Eudes and his son Emeric defeated the invaders, pursued them to the passes, forced them to ask for terms, and then, without a second pitched battle, a truce was concluded which fixed the border along the Pyrenees with Septimania remaining Andalusi. After those two battles the northern offensive of al-Andalus was arrested for a full twelve years, and it was not until 732 that a stronger force marched north again, only to be beaten by Charles Martel between Poitiers and Tours. So far as this campaign itself is concerned, the confirmable results are these: al-Ghafiqi was killed, al-Andalus lost military control of Bordeaux, and the coalition gained the strategic initiative north of the Pyrenees. The details of the fighting, however, have almost all perished; no reliable record survives of the casualties, of the real strength of the two armies, or of their formations, and the shape of the war can only be pieced together from such notices as the chronicles' pursuit to the passes and from the sequence in which the defeats of 719 and 720 follow one another in the narrative.
